completedBody: This update has been installed and Nimi is ready to use.
failed: Update failed. You can retry; your current version remains available.
bridgeUnavailable: Update status is unavailable. Try again.
installationUnavailable: Installation is not available in this build.

phases.idle: Updates are checked in the background.
phases.current: Nimi checks for updates in the background and lets you know when a new version is available.
phases.unavailable: No product release is available yet.
phases.canceled: Download canceled. Your current version is unchanged.
phases.unsupported: Updates are unavailable on this platform.
phases.awaiting-activation: Confirming the running version and Runtime health…
phases.completed: Nimi was updated and is healthy.
phases.recovery-required: The update needs repair. Preserve your data and use the verified formal installer.

reasons.UPDATE_RELEASE_NOT_FOUND: No product release is available yet.
reasons.UPDATE_TRUST_NOT_CONFIGURED: Update verification is not configured for this build.
reasons.UPDATE_UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE: The update service is unavailable. Try again later.
reasons.UPDATE_METADATA_INVALID: The update information is invalid. Update stopped.
reasons.UPDATE_METADATA_EXPIRED: The update information has expired. Check again later.
reasons.UPDATE_SIGNATURE_INVALID: Update authenticity could not be verified. Update stopped.
reasons.UPDATE_ASSET_INVALID: The released package identity is invalid. Update stopped.
reasons.UPDATE_COHORT_INVALID: The product components do not match. Update stopped.
reasons.UPDATE_VERSION_INVALID: The product version is invalid. Update stopped.
reasons.UPDATE_COMPATIBILITY_INVALID: This update is incompatible with your current product or system.
reasons.UPDATE_TARGET_MISMATCH: This update is for another platform. Update stopped.
reasons.UPDATE_CHANNEL_MISMATCH: This update is for another release channel. Update stopped.
reasons.UPDATE_TARGET_UNSUPPORTED: Updates are unavailable on this platform.
reasons.UPDATE_CACHE_UNSAFE: The update cache cannot be used safely. Update stopped.
reasons.UPDATE_DISK_SPACE_INSUFFICIENT: There is not enough disk space to download the update.
reasons.UPDATE_ASSET_SIZE_MISMATCH: The downloaded package is incomplete or has an unexpected size.
reasons.UPDATE_ASSET_DIGEST_MISMATCH: The downloaded package failed integrity verification. Update stopped.
reasons.UPDATE_INSTALLER_TRUST_FAILED: The installer could not be verified. Update stopped.
reasons.UPDATE_INSTALLER_UNSUPPORTED: A trusted installer is not available for this platform yet.
reasons.UPDATE_DOWNLOAD_FAILED: The update could not be downloaded. Try again.
reasons.UPDATE_CANCELED: Download canceled. Your current version is unchanged.
reasons.UPDATE_INSTALL_NOT_READY: Installation is unavailable. Check again after the required verification is ready.
reasons.UPDATE_CANDIDATE_CHANGED: The available update changed. Check again and confirm the version before continuing.
reasons.UPDATE_CRITICAL_CLEANUP_FAILED: Apps or critical resources did not close safely. Nothing was installed. Restart Nimi before trying again.
reasons.UPDATE_HANDOFF_FAILED: The installer handoff failed. Nothing has been confirmed installed.
reasons.UPDATE_HANDOFF_INVALID: The update handoff could not be verified. Repair your installation using the verified official installer.
reasons.UPDATE_AUTHORIZATION_CANCELED: System permission was canceled. The update was not installed.
reasons.UPDATE_INSTALL_FAILED: Installation failed. Keep your data intact and try again using the verified official installer.
reasons.UPDATE_RUNTIME_HANDOFF_FAILED: Runtime could not stop safely. Installation was stopped.
reasons.UPDATE_PARENT_EXIT_FAILED: Nimi did not close in time. The update was not installed.
reasons.UPDATE_ACTIVATION_IDENTITY_FAILED: The running product does not match the approved update. Repair your installation using the verified official installer.
reasons.UPDATE_RUNTIME_HEALTH_FAILED: The updated Runtime is not healthy. Preserve your data and follow its repair guidance.
reasons.UPDATE_RUNTIME_APPROVAL_REQUIRED: Approve Nimi Runtime in System Settings to finish the update.
reasons.UPDATE_HOME_REOPEN_FAILED: Home could not reopen. Use the verified installer and the independent Recovery.txt instructions.
reasons.UPDATE_CHECK_UNAVAILABLE: Checking is paused until Nimi safely restarts.
reasons.UPDATE_REOPEN_BLOCKED: Nimi could not stop safely. It remains open; resolve the running App or resource issue and try the safe restart again.
reasons.UPDATE_RECOVERY_STATE_FAILED: Update diagnostics are unavailable. Nimi can still start or safely restart when its safety checks pass.
reasons.UPDATE_REOPEN_UNAVAILABLE: A current-version restart is not available in this state.
reasons.UPDATE_SERVICE_STOP_FAILED: Runtime did not stop safely. Keep your data intact and repair your installation using the verified official installer.
reasons.UPDATE_SERVICE_START_FAILED: The installed Runtime could not start. Keep your data intact and follow the Runtime repair guidance.
reasons.UPDATE_HANDOFF_IN_PROGRESS: Another Nimi update is still in progress. Wait for it to finish before trying again.

confirmBody: Running apps and tasks will stop. Nimi will close, request system permission if needed, and return to Home. You can update later.
reopenRequired: Nothing was installed. Restart the current version to recreate closed resources and resume work.
